description: Turn supplied product facts into deterministic, editable listing copy without inventing claims. Returns an evidence-bounded result and the canonical web tool URL.

audience.description: Who the product is for, as a short phrase such as independent design teams.

differentiator.description: Optional: what your approach does differently from existing options. Only stated facts are used.

outcome.description: The specific result a user gets once the problem is solved.

problem.description: The concrete problem your audience has today, in your own words. The copy is built from this text and does not add claims.
